    (hK : finrank ℚ K = 2) (phi : K →+* ℂ)
    (t : Fin 3 → 𝓞 K) (ht : IsD1Tuple t)
    (hsmall : ∀ i, ‖phi (t i : K)‖ < 3) :
    ∃ (tau nu : ℤ) (e : QuadInt tau nu ≃+* 𝓞 K),
      ((tau = 0 ∧ nu = 1) ∨ (tau = 0 ∧ nu = 2) ∨
       (tau = 1 ∧ nu = 1) ∨ (tau = 1 ∧ nu = 2)) ∧
      tripleCoordinates (e.symm (t 0)) (e.symm (t 1)) (e.symm (t 2)) ∈
        smallTripleTable tau nu

ProperCommonExtension.map_equiv
    {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [DecidableEq R] [DecidableEq S]
    (e : R ≃+* S) (A : Finset R) (z : R) (hz : ProperCommonExtension A z) :
    ProperCommonExtension (A.image e) (e z)

smallExtensionSymmetry_involutive {tau nu : ℤ} (sgn conj : Bool) :
    Function.Involutive (smallExtensionSymmetry (tau := tau) (nu := nu) sgn conj)

smallExtensionSymmetry_zero {tau nu : ℤ} (sgn conj : Bool) :
    smallExtensionSymmetry (tau := tau) (nu := nu) sgn conj 0 = 0

smallExtensionSymmetry_norm {tau nu : ℤ} (sgn conj : Bool)
    (z : QuadInt tau nu) : (smallExtensionSymmetry sgn conj z).norm = z.norm

SmallTripleExtensionProperty.symmetry {tau nu : ℤ}
    (A : Finset (QuadInt tau nu)) (hA : SmallTripleExtensionProperty A)
    (sgn conj : Bool) :
    SmallTripleExtensionProperty (A.image (smallExtensionSymmetry sgn conj))

smallCoordinateSet_triple {tau nu : ℤ} (a b c : QuadInt tau nu) :
    smallCoordinateSet tau nu (tripleCoordinates a b c) = {a,b,c}

smallTripleExtensionProperty_of_orbit {tau nu : ℤ}
    (row row' : Finset (ℤ × ℤ))
    (hrow : SmallTripleExtensionProperty (smallCoordinateSet tau nu row))

SmallTripleExtensionProperty.full_ring
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K]
    {tau nu : ℤ} (e : QuadInt tau nu ≃+* 𝓞 K) (phi : K →+* ℂ)
    (A : Finset (QuadInt tau nu)) (hA : SmallTripleExtensionProperty A) :
    (∀ z : 𝓞 K, ProperCommonExtension (A.image e) z →
      ‖phi (z : K)‖^2 ≤ (10 : ℝ)^80 → ‖phi (z : K)‖ < 85) ∧
    (∀ z w : 𝓞 K, ProperCommonExtension (A.image e) z →
      ProperCommonExtension (A.image e) w →
      ‖phi (z : K)‖^2 ≤ (10 : ℝ)^80 →
      ‖phi (w : K)‖^2 ≤ (10 : ℝ)^80 → z = w)
